rationale: Post-evaluation AI correction of the shared-scope loss identified in fam-names-03-u05. Merge the unchanged-ID duty and its detached trigger, and expand the exact source quote to the full d(3) paragraph so the within-one-year and DS-11 conditions qualify the duty. The actor is the explicit Applicants phrase to which they refers. The separate ID waiver remains current. The action evidence uses must submit, which is unique within this wider quote, rather than the repeated word submit. No interpretation of the exact one-year anniversary boundary is added; both source conditions remain uninterpreted text and review remains pending.

replacements.summary: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on form DS-11 must submit their name change documentation if their ID has not yet been changed.
replacements.actor: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11

replacements.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name. However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
